a.lede: WIRED is tallying up how many times Nvidia’s interim CEO has assured everyone that the company has everything under control.
a.title: Does Nvidia Got This? Interim CEO Colette Kress Says It’s Got This

b.lede: Despite pressure from President Trump, Elon Musk, and Silicon Valley executives, Nvidia’s board says it “does not intend” to reinstate the company’s ousted CEO.
b.title: Nvidia’s Board Has No Plans to Bring Back Jensen Huang
